text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia sets up state agency for information for youth on training, education, job and leisure opportunities.
- Research must play key role in development of Tunisia's agriculture in next few years.
- Railway company SNCFT prepares for transport of cereals crops due to start next month.
- Tunisia elected member of Arabsat's board meeting in Jordan.
- President Ben Ali receives message from Senegalese President Diouf.
- Italy's President Scalfaro calls for increasing cooperation with Tunisia.
- Procedures for trade exchanges eased at Rades port with establishment of single bureau for all proceedings.
